title: C rpl: DAO TX state machine (reserve_next/finalize_signed) over the two-slot primitive
description: Child of b7z9.11, lands after the C two-slot primitive. Port rust/lichen-rpl/src/persistence.rs DaoTxState (lines 252-329) to C: provision (pubkey+local_origin+instance+dodagid payload, generation 1), reserve_next (generation+1 persisted BEFORE TX with the tx-state payload), finalize_signed (persist exact signed bytes for the reserved sequence; reject sequence mismatch, oversized, already-finalized), open/load on boot (missing/corrupt -> stop origination per R-09-014/016), no equal-sequence rebuild, terminal at u64 max (no wrap). Payload layout must be documented and cross-checked against the Rust encode_tx_state (pubkey 32 + origin 16 + instance + dodagid 16 + sequence u64 + signed-dao bytes/bounds). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.11.
close_reason: Slice 2 of b7z9.11.2 landed: DAO TX state boot-time open/provision in C (rpl_dao_tx_persist.{c,h} extended; C port of rust persistence.rs DaoTxState::open/provision :133-230) over the lichen_hal two-slot primitive — Rust taxonomy parity (Missing/Corrupt/KeyMismatch/ScopeMismatch/StorageError; provision Already/Corrupt with Exists->Corrupt mapping and distinct storage-error propagation), key and scope (origin/instance/dodag) validation with Rust's check precedence, exact-length signed-DAO gate, full structural validation (reserved/CRC) as the final Corrupt gate. Host tests extended in tests/rpl_dao_tx_persist (Missing->provision OK->re-open/Already, key/scope mismatch, provision-over-corrupt, trailing garbage, storage error, NULL guards). Gates: ctest green under ASan/UBSan, gcc -Werror -Wconversion clean, cppcheck clean. Reviews via kimi-k3: pass1 correctness found provision mapping storage errors as CORRUPT + Rust check-order divergence — both fixed to parity; pass2 security PASS (incl. uninit-struct-after-failed-parse check); pass3 edge timed out twice (600s/180s) -> self-review fallback: gen-0/u64-max/signed-len bounds verified, slot selection delegated to the tested open_redundant. Remaining slices for this bead: reserve_next/finalize_signed/clear_transmitted (require the signed-Dao-envelope sequence validation) — follow-up needed after this slice; filing noted in parent b7z9.11 chain.
